units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 2. The accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted by a person holding a municipal office in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption are verified by decision of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by a law of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 3. If verification conducted under part 2 of this Article reveals failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation applies to the local self-government body authorized to take the relevant decision, or to a court, for early termination of the powers of the person holding a municipal office or for another measure of liability to be imposed on that person.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 4. The following measures of liability may be imposed on a person holding a municipal office who has submitted inaccurate or incomplete information on their income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations, or such information concerning their spouse and minor children, where the distortion of that information is insignificant:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 1) a warning;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 2) release of the person holding a municipal office from their position in the relevant local self-government body, with deprivation of the right to hold positions in that body until the expiry of their term of office;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 3) release from the exercise of powers on a full-time basis, with deprivation of the right to exercise powers on a full-time basis until the expiry of the term of office;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 4) prohibition on holding positions in the relevant local self-government body until the expiry of the term of office;
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 5) prohibition on exercising powers on a full-time basis until the expiry of the term of office.
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 5. The procedure for deciding to impose the measures of liability specified in part 4 of this Article on a person holding a municipal office is determined by a municipal legal act in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 6. Persons holding municipal offices are exempt from liability for failure to observe restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established by this Federal Law and other federal laws for the purposes of combating corruption, if that failure is recognized as resulting from circumstances beyond their control in accordance with the procedure provided for in parts 3–6 of Article 13 of Federal Law of 25.12.2008 No. 273-ФЗ “On Combating Corruption”.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 7. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may issue a warning or reprimand to the head of a municipality or the head of the local administration for improper performance or non-performance of duties to ensure that local self-government bodies exercise individual state powers delegated to them by federal laws and/or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 8. Guarantees of the rights of persons holding municipal offices when they are subjected to criminal or administrative liability, apprehension, detention, search, interrogation or other criminal procedural or administrative procedural actions, and when operational investigative measures are conducted in respect of those persons, their residential and/or official premises, their luggage, personal and official vehicles, correspondence, means of communication used by them, and documents belonging to them, are established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 9. Persons holding municipal offices may not be subjected to criminal or administrative liability for opinions expressed, positions taken in voting or other actions consistent with their status, including after the expiry of their terms of office. This provision does not apply where those persons have committed public insults, defamation or other violations for which liability is provided by federal law.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 10. A person holding a municipal office’s participation in collective decision-making (including voting on agenda items), or performance of other duties of the office provided for by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, does not constitute a ground for holding that person liable for failure to comply with requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest under the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.label: Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 1. The powers of a person holding a municipal office terminate early in the following cases:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 1) death;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 2) voluntary resignation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 3) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 4) being declared missing or dead by a court;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 5) a court judgment of conviction against the person becoming legally effective;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 6) departure from the Russian Federation for permanent residence abroad;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 7) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation, or possession of citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 8) early termination of the powers of the relevant local self-government body;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 9) conscription for military service or assignment to alternative civilian service in its place;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 10) acquisition of foreign agent status;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 11) other cases established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 2. A deputy’s powers in the municipal representative body are terminated early by a decision of that body if the deputy is absent without valid reasons from all its meetings for six consecutive months.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 3. A deputy of the municipal representative body whose powers that body has decided to terminate early may apply to a court to challenge the decision within 10 days after its official publication.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 4. If a deputy of the municipal representative body whose powers have been terminated early by a decision of that body challenges the decision in court, the representative body may not decide to call by-elections of deputies until the court decision becomes legally effective.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 5. A decision of the municipal representative body to terminate a deputy’s powers early is adopted no later than 30 days after the ground for early termination arises; if the ground arises between sessions of the representative body, the decision is adopted no later than three months after that ground arises.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 6. If the municipal representative body fails to adopt a decision to terminate a deputy’s powers early on the ground provided for in point 2 of part 1 of this Article within the time limits provided for in part 5 of this Article, the deputy may apply to a court to challenge the representative body’s inaction in accordance with the procedure provided for by procedural legislation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Early termination of the powers of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 7. Where the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation applies for early termination of a deputy’s powers in the municipal representative body, the day the ground for early termination arises is the day that body receives the application.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 31. Municipal service
units.text: Article 31. Municipal service
units.label: Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Municipal service
units.text: Municipal service, including requirements for municipal service positions, the status of municipal servants, and the conditions and procedure for performing municipal service, is legally regulated by federal law and by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters and other municipal legal acts adopted in accordance with it.
units.label: Art. 31 · text

units.text: Chapter 4. Functional foundations of the organization of local self-government

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.label: Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 1. The powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life that may not be redistributed between local self-government bodies and state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation include:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 1) adoption of the municipal charter and amendments and additions to it, and issue of municipal legal acts;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 2) establishment of the municipality’s official symbols;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 3) preparation and consideration of the draft municipal budget, approval and execution of the local budget, municipal financial control, including control over execution of the municipal budget, and preparation and approval of the report on local budget execution in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 4) possession, use and disposal of municipally owned property;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 5) establishment, introduction and termination of previously introduced municipal local taxes and fees in accordance with the legislation on taxes and fees;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 6) participation in protecting citizens’ health in the municipality, including ensuring access to medical care, in accordance with Federal Law of 21.11.2011 No. 323-ФЗ “On the Fundamentals of Health Protection of Citizens in the Russian Federation”, including in creating conditions for providing medical care to the population (except in territories included in the list approved by the Government of the Russian Federation of territories whose populations receive medical care in medical organizations subordinate to the federal executive authority responsible for medical and sanitary support of the populations of certain territories), in accordance with the territorial program of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 7) organizational and logistical support for the preparation and conduct of municipal elections and local referendums;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 8) development of courtyard areas;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 9) establishment of a print media outlet and/or online publication to promulgate municipal legal acts and bring official information to the attention of municipal residents;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 10) establishment of municipal enterprises and institutions, provision of funding for the activities of municipal treasury-funded institutions and for the performance of municipal assignments by municipal budgetary and autonomous institutions;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 11) setting tariffs for services provided and work performed by municipal enterprises and institutions, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 12) implementation of measures to combat corruption within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 13) participation in preventing terrorism and extremism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of manifestations of terrorism and extremism within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 14) participation in preventing emergencies and eliminating their consequences within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 15) organization and implementation of mobilization preparedness measures for municipal enterprises and institutions located in the municipality;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 16) maintaining records of citizens who retain the right to a social payment to purchase housing outside territories formerly included in closed administrative-territorial formations in respect of which the President of the Russian Federation has decided on transformation or abolition, in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on closed administrative-territorial formations; determining the amount of that payment; monitoring citizens’ compliance with the conditions for receiving it; and exercising the right to pay the cost of travel of citizens and their family members from their former to their new place of residence and the cost of transporting their luggage;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 17) conducting international and foreign economic relations in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 18) exercising municipal control over compliance with requirements established by municipal legal acts adopted on matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 2. The powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life that may be redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by state authorities of that constituent entity include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 1) organization of electricity, heat, gas and water supplies to the population, wastewater disposal and fuel supplies to the population within the municipality’s boundaries, within the powers established by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 2) provision of housing to low-income citizens residing in the municipality who need housing, organization of construction and maintenance of the municipal housing stock, creation of conditions for housing construction, decisions approving the alteration of installations and replanning of premises in apartment buildings, and exercise of other powers of local self-government bodies under housing legislation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 3) provision of premises for an officer holding the position of district police commissioner to work in the administrative district of the municipality served by that officer;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 4) organization of generally accessible and free preschool, primary general, basic general and secondary general education under basic general education programs in municipal educational organizations (except powers to finance the implementation of basic general education programs in accordance with federal state educational standards); organization of supplementary education for children in municipal educational organizations (except supplementary education for children financed by state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation); organization of supplementary education for adults under supplementary sports training programs in municipal educational organizations; and creation of conditions for supervision and care of children and for their upkeep in municipal educational organizations;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 5) ensuring conditions for the development of physical culture and sport in the municipality, including promoting the development and accessibility of mass sport, developing children’s and youth sport (including school sport), and organizing and holding official municipal physical culture and sports events;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 6) implementation, within their powers, of measures to ensure the organization of children’s recreation during school holidays, including measures to protect their lives and health;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 7) creation of conditions for providing municipal residents with communications, catering, retail and consumer services;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 32
